mapper.select: select uf.focus_user_id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.image as user_image, ui.introduction as introduction from user_focus uf join user_info ui on uf.user_id = ui.user_id where uf.user_id = #{userId} order by uf.create_time desc

select uf.user_id as user_id, ui.user_name as user_name, ui.image as user_image, ui.introduction as introduction, case when EXISTS ( select 1 from user_focus uf2 where uf.user_id = uf2.focus_user_id and uf2.user_id = #{user_id} ) then 1 else 0 end as is_follow_each_other from user_focus uf join user_info ui on uf.focus_user_id = ui.user_id where uf.focus_user_id = #{userId} order by uf.create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into user_focus (user_id, focus_user_id, create_time, source) values (#{userId}, #{focusUserId}, now(), #{source})
mapper.select: select count(*) from user_focus where user_id = #{userId} and focus_user_id = #{focusUserId}
